features.title: Overview
features.description: Clock/date, current weather, three upcoming plans and recent photos. Three layout presets; optional note excerpt. Overview remains anchored to today.

features.title: Weather
features.description: Current conditions, hourly and five-day forecasts, nine scenes, saved/offline recovery, city/time/units, sunrise/sunset. Automatic colour mode computes solar times offline.

features.title: Photos
features.description: Shared album or private email-photo cache; library, browse/zoom and three slideshow styles. Favourite/hide/Fit/Fill/caption, shuffle/repeat/favourites-only, optional trusted senders and bounded polling.

features.title: Calendar
features.description: Read-only private feeds; Month, Week and Today, visibility chips, loaded-title search, event details and local countdown action. Metadata editing and optional inviter review.

features.title: Household · optional
features.description: On-frame note and shopping checklist with completion undo, up to five countdowns and three visible timers. Off in default navigation; no phone-sync or background-alarm promise.

features.title: Home
features.description: External Google Home launcher with a first-use checklist. Optional rail item. Account sign-in and real controls require owner verification.

features.title: YouTube
features.description: External mobile/standard launcher, optional six curated shortcuts and exact-host validation. Browser behavior depends on the frame’s WebView.

features.title: Settings
features.description: Eight categories; six palettes with light/dark/astronomical automatic mode, larger text, Momo preferences and two seasonal accessories. Coarse service health, private-content pause, quiet hours and non-secret display transfer.

features.title: Setup guide
features.description: Fresh-install setup, optional skip, return links, progress cues and explicit verification steps. Never prefills household credentials.

screenChanges.title: A balanced, adaptive dashboard
screenChanges.change: Fluid landscape layout and three bounded presets. Labelled Forecast and Calendar routes, large clickable weather/event surfaces, a safe gap beneath photos, today-anchored plans, contextual Calendar setup and an optional one-line household note. Healthy timestamps stay in Settings.

screenChanges.title: A compact forecast
screenChanges.change: Shorter current-condition hero, readable forecast rows, sunrise in the supporting note and a Change city route to the shared editor. Saved forecast and retry states remain explicit. All nine existing scenes retain day/night variants.

screenChanges.title: A full-width photo library
screenChanges.change: The library uses the available width. Photo settings opens the shared category with a return route. Coarse saved/checking/checked status, slideshow and manual check remain visible; favourites and reversible hide choices survive refresh/reload.

screenChanges.title: A compact shared-album launcher
screenChanges.change: Source switching remains in Photos. Album and idle configuration share the Settings editor. The page identifies Google’s player separately from Skylit’s email-photo styles and offline cache.

screenChanges.title: Photo options only when needed
screenChanges.change: Browse and Slideshow labels distinguish modes. An Options drawer holds favourite, hide, Fit/Fill, local caption and received date. Closing restores thumbnail focus; keyboard focus stays in the player. Shuffle, repeat and favourites-only are optional.

screenChanges.title: Presentation, Delivery and Storage
screenChanges.change: Broad presentation/delivery groups, a collapsed account form with empty credential fields, import-verification guidance and a separate storage/erase area. Bounded polling, exact-address trusted senders and progress counts use native private storage.

screenChanges.title: Month, Week and Today without page scrolling
screenChanges.change: Management is grouped under Calendar options. Pending inviter review appears only when needed. Source chips toggle visibility; search opens on demand and covers loaded dates. The month grid fits the landscape canvas and the agenda scrolls internally.

screenChanges.title: A shared editor with a return route
screenChanges.change: Back to Calendar, connected labels and refresh state precede the add form. Labels/colours change without revealing or re-entering a feed URL. Removal remains confirmed; private-link instructions use the agreed read-only integration.

screenChanges.title: Decisions before setup
screenChanges.change: Pending review comes first, approved inviters next, and owner/policy setup lives in a disclosure. Exact-address Show/Hide on frame decisions update Calendar and Overview. Loaded-date and read-only limits remain explicit.

screenChanges.title: A compact external-service panel
screenChanges.change: One primary launch action, an owner verification checklist and an optional navigation toggle. The UI asks the owner to confirm a real device operation; it does not infer authenticated controls.

screenChanges.title: Layout beside launch
screenChanges.change: Mobile/standard layout and launch live together. Up to six owner-entered public video/playlist shortcuts are optional; both JavaScript and native code validate exact HTTPS destinations. External playback/return still needs frame acceptance.

screenChanges.title: Eight focused categories
screenChanges.change: Appearance, Momo, Weather & time, Photos, Calendars, Household, Services and Device & status. One existing editor is reused per preference. Larger text, live appearance preview and six light/dark pairs remain independent. Recovery actions and advanced device controls stay here. Saving feedback reserves its space.

screenChanges.title: Configured and verified are distinct
screenChanges.change: The guide distinguishes credentials/configuration from a received picture or refreshed feed, remembers its current step, and offers Continue setup from the shared editors. Existing-install launch suppression remains covered by tests.

roadmap.title: Service status and guided recovery
roadmap.why: A network indicator and saved credential do not prove a feature works. Failures need a useful next action, not a generic Connected label.
roadmap.mvp: A local status panel with last successful weather fetch, calendar parse, mail check and cached-picture count; each service offers Retry or its setup route. Keep Home as owner-verified, never infer remote authentication.
roadmap.done: Offline data remains usable; status contains no URLs, mail identity, event details or tokens; each recovery action is tested.
roadmap.depends: Existing coarse native status and caches; actual-frame verification.
roadmap.evidence: Browser recovery flows and offline synthetic states; native/API build verified. Real service checks remain in the acceptance list.

roadmap.title: Unattended reliability and acceptance pass
roadmap.why: Docs explicitly leave long-term mail polling, age pruning, fresh Android setup, live inviter rules and Home operations open.
roadmap.mvp: Run a documented multi-day frame soak, upgrade/restart/offline tests, bounded-cache pruning and owner-led real calendar-change/inviter checks. Record results privately with labels only.
roadmap.done: No stuck player/import, lost settings, stale-feed resurrection or unbounded cache; unresolved compatibility issues are visible in the UI.
roadmap.depends: Identified device and owner participation for household tests. No factory reset or destructive reinstall.
roadmap.evidence: Acceptance procedure prepared. No deployment, fresh install, upgrade, restart or multi-day soak was performed in this pass.

roadmap.title: Configurable email-photo refresh and progress
roadmap.why: The current importer checks at most once a day after a successful check, plus manual Check now. Newly emailed pictures can feel late.
roadmap.mvp: Offer bounded 15-minute, hourly or daily polling; show Checking, last success, received count and actionable failure. Use one in-flight check and network/error backoff; keep the current manual check.
roadmap.done: A newly sent test image appears within the selected online window; retries do not overlap or remove the last good cache.
roadmap.depends: Native PhotoMail scheduling; battery/network/large-inbox testing on the frame.
roadmap.evidence: 15-minute/hourly/daily checks, single-flight import, progress and bounded retry backoff. Java policy tests pass; a real delivery window remains unverified.

roadmap.title: Photo favourites, hide and fit/fill
roadmap.why: A displayed family photo deserves selection and intentional cropping. A cache of 30–50 pictures needs more control than next/previous.
roadmap.mvp: Favourite and hide from playback, reversible local choices, Fit/Fill per photo and a shuffle toggle. Let Overview prefer favourites; avoid changing or deleting email messages.
roadmap.done: Hidden pictures stay out of all playback modes and Overview; undo works; portrait faces survive Fit; curation survives a harmless refresh.
roadmap.depends: Stable deduplicated photo IDs; retention/account-change semantics and bounded local state.
roadmap.evidence: Stable photo IDs, bounded choices, hide/restore/undo, fit/fill and refresh/reload persistence tested with synthetic pictures.

roadmap.title: Today/Week agenda and calendar filters
roadmap.why: A month is good for orientation; households often need the next few hours, a week or one calendar's plans.
roadmap.mvp: Read-only Today and Week agenda modes plus per-calendar visibility chips. Remember the view locally; keep Today obvious and details accessible.
roadmap.done: Overnight/all-day/DST and dense days remain readable; hiding a feed is reversible; Overview still uses today and the agreed visibility rules.
roadmap.depends: Existing parsed feeds and race/removal guards; no OAuth or event editing.
roadmap.evidence: Parser/timezone/race tests plus rendered modes/search/source filters; the independent Overview regression still passes.

roadmap.title: Household note and shopping checklist
roadmap.why: Adds a reason to touch the frame beyond weather/photos without needing another hosted service.
roadmap.mvp: One editable pinned note and a short shopping list stored on this frame; large add/check/undo controls. Overview can show a small optional excerpt.
roadmap.done: Works offline and after restart; labels clearly say On this frame; a household can recover accidental completion.
roadmap.depends: Single-frame MVP. Phone synchronization is a separate product/integration decision; do not imply Google Keep sync.
roadmap.evidence: Local note/list/undo/countdowns/timers persist after browser reload; optional feature and excerpt remain off by default.

roadmap.title: Quiet hours and a privacy pause
roadmap.why: Automatic palette switching already follows the sun, but households may want control over what is displayed overnight or while guests visit.
roadmap.mvp: An optional schedule for ambient display plus a manual pause that hides photos/event content with a clear restore action. Keep astronomical colour mode independent.
roadmap.done: Schedules respect configured local time/DST; no automatic interruption of active video or manual browsing; touch reliably restores the dashboard.
roadmap.depends: Native idle-state coordination; hardware brightness is a separate optional capability to investigate, not promised.
roadmap.evidence: Configured-city/DST policy tests and browser privacy restore pass. Native idle lifecycle code compiles; actual touch, idle and video non-interruption await testing.

roadmap.title: Overview presets and optional navigation
roadmap.why: Different households care most about photos or plans; unused service tabs consume attention.
roadmap.mvp: Three bounded presets: Balanced, Photos first, Agenda first. Toggle optional Home/YouTube rail entries and keep four core destinations fixed.
roadmap.done: Each preset fits 1280×720 with long content and missing sources; Today remains stable; no hidden destination strands the user.
roadmap.depends: Reliable Settings categories and shared layout rules; avoid a freeform widget builder initially.
roadmap.evidence: Balanced/Photos/Agenda presets and optional Home/YouTube navigation are Settings preferences. Default rail stays familiar.

roadmap.title: Readable display profile
roadmap.why: High contrast exists, but some owners need larger text and controls while keeping Linen or Sage.
roadmap.mvp: A modest/large text preference, consistent 48–56px frequent targets and visible keyboard focus; retain optional High contrast and motion controls.
roadmap.done: All tabs, panels and players work at the largest supported size; no hidden labels, clipped agenda or horizontal scrolling.
roadmap.depends: Token-based typography/layout audit; rendered contrast checks in all pairs.
roadmap.evidence: Standard/larger profiles pass all nine viewport checks; six palettes and their contrast rules remain covered.

roadmap.title: Trusted photo senders
roadmap.why: Anyone who can send a picture to the dedicated inbox can currently place it on the display.
roadmap.mvp: An opt-in allowlist checked before saving attachments, with a coarse skipped count and clear rules. Store the minimum sender-policy data privately.
roadmap.done: Unapproved senders cannot place pictures; disabling/changing the rule has defined cache behaviour; sender matching is not presented as cryptographic identity proof.
roadmap.depends: Importer/MIME tests and privacy review; complete basic import reliability first.
roadmap.evidence: Exact normalized sender matching is enforced before new attachments are saved; default is off. Pure Java policy tests pass. Existing cache is kept until explicitly erased.

roadmap.title: Manual calendar visibility and friendly labels
roadmap.why: Owners should be able to rename/recolour/hide a source without deleting and reconnecting its private feed.
roadmap.mvp: Edit label and colour, toggle visibility and show separate refresh health for each source.
roadmap.done: No feed URL is exposed or re-entered for a label change; visibility immediately updates both month/agenda and Overview.
roadmap.depends: Native metadata editing plus worker-generation regression coverage.
roadmap.evidence: Rename/recolour and visibility are independent of secret feeds. Rendered metadata editing and filtering pass. Android store test cases are prepared but require the frame.

ideas.title: Photo replay controls
ideas.detail: Shuffle, repeat, favourites-only and safe unavailable-image handling.

ideas.title: Photo captions and dates
ideas.detail: Local caption and received date in Options; no inferred people or original capture date.

ideas.title: Slideshow style preview
ideas.detail: Three small motion-aware samples in Presentation.

ideas.title: Agenda search and next-event focus
ideas.detail: Title search over loaded dates; event drill-down and a local day countdown. No continuous live event notification.

ideas.title: Weather detail choices
ideas.detail: Sunrise joins the supporting Weather note; Overview keeps three metrics. Existing feels-like details remain. Gust controls were not added.

ideas.title: Local countdowns
ideas.detail: Up to five dates in Household; an event can supply a date. Overview supports only a note excerpt to keep the dashboard calm.

ideas.title: Timers and reminders
ideas.detail: Three visible on-frame timers with persisted end times and dismissal. No native alarm, audio, phone alert or background delivery.

ideas.title: A small Momo wardrobe expansion
ideas.detail: Autumn leaf and Winter earmuffs; Still/reduced motion and daily routine remain supported.

ideas.title: Owner-curated YouTube shortcuts
ideas.detail: Exact HTTPS video/playlist validation, optional owner titles and restart persistence. No playback claim from a rendered shortcut.

ideas.title: Manual local photo import
ideas.detail: Android document selection is a possible path, but exact frame file-provider/USB behavior and safe image-cache integration need device research first.

ideas.title: Voice shopping-list capture
ideas.detail: Recognizer availability and recognition/privacy behavior need checks on this frame before choosing an API or requesting microphone access.

ideas.title: A direct local home-control adapter
ideas.detail: First verify actual Home operations and select a supported integration. No guessed device state or new service was added.

ideas.title: Non-secret preference transfer
ideas.detail: Strict display-settings allowlist. Browser file export/import; frame copy/paste. Feeds, links, photos, accounts, city, notes and inviter identities are excluded.

ideas.title: Broad cloud/photo/calendar expansion
ideas.detail: Editable Calendar/OAuth, hosted sync, arbitrary embeds, automatic photo analysis and DRM services remain outside the current scope.

acceptance: Identify the exact frame model, Android version and authenticated transport before installing. Use the existing signed upgrade path; preserve app data, signing key, original launcher and device settings. No factory reset or firmware change.
Inspect all affected tabs on the physical 1920×1080 screen and the actual WebView 95. Check standard/larger text, six theme pairs, dense dates and the full Settings return routes.

Check first-run guide on a non-destructive test install; on the existing frame, verify upgrade preserves settings and does not reopen setup. Reopen Settings → Device & status → Setup guide and follow its links.

Email: send a real test image to the dedicated account, confirm import within the selected interval, slide advance, manual check, offline cache and first-touch idle return. Check trusted/unapproved senders and retain/erase/disconnect effects using private records only.

Calendar: owner changes an actual event, then verify refreshed event behavior, today-anchored Overview, hide/show, rename/recolour, inviter approval/revocation/cancellation and removal during refresh. Keep feed URLs and event details out of reports and logs.

Quiet hours: test configured-city boundary and overnight behavior, idle disabled, no saved photos, active manual browse/video, pause restore, Android Back and first touch. Confirm hardware brightness is unchanged.

Run a multi-day unattended acceptance period covering selected mail polling, offline/reconnect, restarts, old-picture pruning and bounded storage. Record measured results; compilation and synthetic previews cannot establish these.
Google Home: owner sign-in and a real supported operation. YouTube: actual deep-link playback, full-screen and reliable Return to Skylit. Never treat the launch page alone as success.

verification.nativeDevice: Not deployed; user requested APK ready for later testing
